facts.fact: Attijari bank says it led a bank consortium in a TND 310 million syndicated loan to the operator Ooredoo, to fund its 5G licence and national network development; no signing date is given.
The TND 310 million 5G loan to Ooredoo was led by Attijari bank, a bank of Tunisia, as lead of a bank consortium, per the bank's own first-quarter 2025 indicators.
